sources.citation: K. Perlin, Improving Noise, SIGGRAPH 2002, ACM TOG 21(3) (the interpolant 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3 and the cube-edge gradients, here on the z = 0 plane)

D. S. Ebert, F. K. Musgrave et al., Texturing and Modeling: A Procedural Approach, 3rd ed., 2003, F. K. Musgrave's chapters on fractal models (fBm with lacunarity 2 and a gain per octave; the ridged multifractal 1 - |noise|, squared)
B. B. Mandelbrot, J. W. Van Ness, Fractional Brownian Motions, Fractional Noises and Applications, SIAM Review 10(4), 1968 (fractional Brownian motion)
A. Lagae et al., A Survey of Procedural Noise Functions, Computer Graphics Forum 29(8), 2010 (periodic lattice noise: the lattice index taken modulo the period, so the texture tiles)
M. Jarzynski, M. Olano, Hash Functions for GPU Rendering, Journal of Computer Graphics Techniques 9(3), 2020 (pcg3d: the lattice hash of every cell)
